title: 第2章 什么叫这里是须弥？
slug: 在须弥假装是一个学者
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“会动的蘑菇？”

“等等？我不会穿越到DND世界了吧？这是什么？噗叽？”

“不对吧？”

王言根本抑制不住脑海中出现的思绪。

虽然他也蛮喜欢DND的，虽然不怎么跑团，但博德之门也没少玩，MOD也没少打，各种伪DND世界观的小说更是没少看。

但…作为一个普通人，目前也没有发现自己有金手指什么的，甚至连个面板都没有…他是真不想穿越到DND世界观的世界里去啊。

这种世界观，他再怎么心大，也难免不安。

正在王言忍不住乱想的时候，不远处，水边的三只蘑菇兽似乎也察觉到了有人靠近。

原本散开的三只蘑菇兽，迅速靠拢在一起，然后做出打量的动作，蘑菇盖下的触手蠕动，三只蘑菇兽，六只空洞的眼睛，迅速锁定了躲在灌木丛后的王言。

被这六只空洞的眼睛一看，王言内心也是一慌。

即便再怎么告诫自己不能慌张，但作为一个现代人，看见这种小半人高，会动的蘑菇，还会用空洞的眼睛瞪你，内心能不慌吗？

这是生理反应，控制不住的。

王言下意识的后退了一步。

这一步，似乎让三只蘑菇兽确认了眼前的人类在害怕。

在野外的食物链中，会害怕自己，就代表对方是自己的食物。

三只蘑菇兽直接蹦起来，冲向王言，不知道是要狩猎，还是要维护自己的地盘。

王言也是一惊，下意识想要转头就跑，但…他的目光，很快就出现了不一样的神色。

这三只蘑菇兽…有点萌。

“怎么有点眼熟？”

只见它们迈着两只小短腿，一步一蹦的冲向王言，但可能是帽子太大，也可能是腿太短…冲刺的速度，堪比正常人饭后散步。

“似乎…不用跑。”

王言内心的惊慌逐渐散去。

“不，不能莽，但也不能露怯…”

目光一扫，王言就看见边上的几块石头，不大，只有小半个拳头，就是不规整，没打磨过，有棱有角的。

“好东西。”

玩过骑砍的都知道，这石头，乃是新人杀手！

多少豪杰，第一滴血，都是被劫匪的石头给砸下来的！

迅速弯腰，捡了最近的三块石头，然后离开灌木丛，小跑几步，和三只蘑菇兽拉开距离。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"A moving mushroom?"

"Wait? I won't travel to the DND world, right? What is this? Puji?"

"Isn't it right?"

Wang Yan couldn't suppress the thoughts that appeared in his mind.

Although he also likes DND a lot, and although he doesn’t run many groups, he plays Baldur’s Gate a lot, plays MODs a lot, and reads a lot of novels about the pseudo-DND worldview.

But... as an ordinary person, he has not found out that he has a golden finger or anything, not even a panel... He really doesn't want to travel to the world of DND world view.

With this worldview, no matter how ambitious he is, he will inevitably feel uneasy.

Just when Wang Yan couldn't help but think about it, not far away, the three mushroom beasts by the water seemed to have noticed someone approaching.

The three mushroom beasts that were originally scattered quickly came together, and then made a sizing movement. The tentacles under the mushroom caps squirmed. The three mushroom beasts and six empty eyes quickly locked onto Wang Yan who was hiding behind the bushes.

Seeing these six empty eyes, Wang Yan panicked in his heart.

No matter how much you warn yourself not to panic, as a modern person, if you see this kind of moving mushroom that is less than half a person tall and will stare at you with empty eyes, can you not panic in your heart?

This is a physiological reaction and cannot be controlled.

Wang Yan subconsciously took a step back.

This step seemed to confirm to the three mushroom beasts that the humans in front of them were afraid.

In the food chain in the wild, being afraid of yourself means that the other person is your food.

The three mushroom beasts jumped up and rushed towards Wang Yan, not sure whether they wanted to hunt or protect their territory.

Wang Yan was also startled and subconsciously wanted to turn around and run away, but... his eyes soon showed a different look.

These three mushroom beasts are...kind of cute.

"Why does it look familiar?"

I saw them walking towards Wang Yan with two short legs, jumping step by step, but maybe the hat was too big, or maybe the legs were too short... The speed of sprinting was comparable to that of a normal person taking a walk after a meal.

"It seems...there is no need to run."

Wang Yan's inner panic gradually dissipated.

"No, you can't be reckless, but you can't show your cowardice either..."

With a quick glance, Wang Yan saw a few stones on the side. They were not big, only half a fist-size. They were irregular, unpolished, and had edges and corners.

"Good stuff."

Anyone who has played horse-cutting knows that this stone is a newcomer killer!

How many heroes lost their first blood by the stones of robbers!

He quickly bent down and picked up the three nearest stones, then left the bush, jogged a few steps, and distanced himself from the three mushroom beasts.
